name: Restaurant Reservations
title: Table reservations
ask: Do you have a table for four on Friday at 7pm?
covers: tables and party sizes, opening hours, menus, dietary options and private dining
rule: Never confirm a table: the restaurant confirms every reservation. Never take a deposit or card details in the chat.
who: Sit-down restaurants that take table bookings and want them separate from takeaway orders: the existing Restaurants & Food Service plug-in is for orders.
author: Bart Cant
